classes.deciding_sentence: Reproduce the observed failure on the same inputs before proposing a cause.
Report the blast radius plus an explicit rotation recommendation handed back to the owner.
The test is executed and observed failing BEFORE the implementation exists, recorded as a red-phase receipt.
Emit resolvable predictions, each with a resolution date and a checkable criterion so calibration can be scored later.
A citation that cannot be fetched is UNRESOLVED, never assumed valid, even when the surrounding paragraph sounds authoritative.
A citation that cannot be fetched is UNRESOLVED, never assumed valid, even when the surrounding paragraph sounds authoritative.
The revert path is exercised in a test so the safety mechanism is not an unproven branch.
Detect an excessive-permission package and a package carrying auto-loading agent config.
The run must be resumable and idempotent across runs while watching a named source for newly arriving evidence.
Produce measured contrast ratios and tap target sizes from a real render rather than a model's opinion.
Flag an underpowered comparison and a result reported without an effect size.
Model evaluation must run against a held-out slice and refuse a verdict computed on the visible slice alone.
Rollback rehearsal actually executes a rollback against a packaged artifact and verifies no user data is lost.
Policy-as-code emits executable policy that is evaluated in CI.
Policy-as-code emits executable policy that is evaluated in CI.
Detect a requirement that silently disappeared between two documents, proven with a planted dropped requirement rather than a keyword overlap score.
Run live incident-response under a war-room clock so containment can start now.
Afterward write a postmortem retrospective that vetoes an unevidenced close and stops only when the causal record is complete.
Cross-vendor-compatibility lists each client explicitly; cartesian leftovers stay UNTESTED and are never inferred from a neighbour cell.
Plugin-conformance refuses unsupported install cells.
Incident lifecycle family: live war room and retrospective postmortem

Plugin-conformance refuses unsupported install cells.
